title: tack session
description: Schema for a tack session file

id.description: Claude Code session identifier, which is also the filename stem

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session first touched a route

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session declared its work finished; absent while the session is live

routes.description: Slugs of the routes this session touched, in first-touch order. A superset of the slugs in `tacks`: a session that opened a route without producing a tack there is recorded here and nowhere else

tacks.description: Tacks this session is driving, as <slug>/t<N> since they land on whatever routes they belong to, in touch order; the last entry is the session's current focus
